name: Jelevision Extras Enricher
description: Identifies anonymous local movie extras with TheDiscDb, a public Jelevision seed, and optional private catalog feeds; correctly classifies trailers and removes confirmed technical/legal reels without deleting media.
overview: Name and classify local trailers and bonus features

versions.changelog: Introduces the hybrid catalog model: public format and seed, optional authenticated production feeds, local-only matching, and unchanged offline fallback behavior.

Initial public release with privacy-preserving local catalog matching, TheDiscDb integration, technical-reel suppression, Preview/Apply/Undo tasks, provenance validation, and bundled offline fallback.
